summary.description: 2-4 sentence overall assessment of the PR.

findings.description: Review findings. Only changed (added/modified) lines may be anchored.

file.description: Repo-relative path, e.g. src/App/Orders/OrderService.cs. Must be a file in the PR diff.

line.description: 1-based line number in the NEW version of the file, inside the diff hunk.

startLine.description: Optional 1-based start of the range (>= line).

endLine.description: Optional 1-based end of the range (>= line).

description.description: 2-6 sentences: why it matters, impact, when it triggers.

suggestion.description: Concrete fix with a code snippet when useful.
